messages:
maria: quick UX check12: new Usage mock attached. main decision: show fiat inline for every row or collapse cost into a persistent chip? figma: https://figma.com/s/usage-cost-chip

devon: chip looks cleaner. prefer `4.2k tokens  $0.23` inline chip so finance sees cost at a glance without crowding columns.

anya: accessibility: chip must be focusable and readable by screen readers. don't rely on hover.

sam: view defaults: org scope -> grouped rollups, project scope -> full list. add a small toggle next to scope pill: `View: Grouped | List`.

maria: agreed. also where to put invoice download? grouped header only or per expanded line? legal wants explicit invoice provenance per line item.

legal-bot: Reminder: invoices must map to a specific billing period and show invoice id. linking per-line to invoice PDF satisfies audit requirements.

devon: compromise: grouped row shows `Statement (PDF)` CTA opening modal; expanded ledger shows per-line `View invoice` link.

anya: keyboard flow: expanding should be Enter on row, focus moves into first cell, `aria-expanded` updated. chip should expose text: "Cost: $0.23" for screen readers.

sam: mobile: default to grouped, use drill-in to see ledger. ledger is too dense on small screens.

maria: I'll update mock: grouped-first with inline chips + statement CTA, expanded ledger with invoice links, ARIA notes. Posting updated figma by EOD.

devon: perf note for infra: grouped view needs pre-aggregated endpoints (median, p95) and sparkline points. I'll sync with infra after mock lands.

anya: once mock posted I'll run a quick a11y pass and test keyboard-only expand/collapse.

maria: thanks all 64f
